name: Sika ViscoFlow-21 AU
paste:
SIKA VISCOFLOW®-21 AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU, August 2024, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika-viscoflow-21au.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU is a workability-enhancing admixture for use in various concrete applications (slump-keeper).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU can be used in conventional, high slump or Self-Compacting Concrete, in precast/prestressed or ready mix applications, or in any application where extended concrete plasticity without excessive retardation is required. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU does not extend slump life through slowing down the hydration process of cement. Besides the slump-retaining effect Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU also offers a minimal water reducing effect, resulting in a lower dosage rate for the primary water reducer in the concrete mix. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU can be used as a stand-alone admixture or in combination with other Sika concrete admixtures.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: WORKABILITY-ENHANCING ADMIXTURE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU meets the requirements of AS1478.1-2000 for Special Purpose Admixture Type (SN).
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1-2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU is a unique concrete admixture used to improve the workability and slump retention of fresh concrete. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU uses innovative polycarboxylate polymer technology, which can be used in various concrete applications whenever extended slump retention and concrete plasticity without set time delay is required. Use of Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU delivers the following benefits to a concrete producer:
    - Extended slump retention without excessive retardation.
    - No need for concrete re-tempering.
    - Better ability to optimize concrete mix designs resulting in cost savings.
    - Ability to adjust slump retention to match transport time and temperature.
    - No deleterious effect on concrete shrinkage.
    - Enhanced early and final strength.
    - Reduced rejection rates due to issues related to concrete re-tempering.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of selected modified polycarboxylates
    - Appearance and colour: Colourless clear liquid
    - Density: 1.05 kg/l
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight, shelf life is 12 months.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from the direct sunlight and frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2024, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU recommended dosage is 200 ml to 1000 ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials.
    - Compatibility: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU can be used in conjunction with all the Sika Concrete admixtures with the exclusion of Sikament NN. All admixtures must be added separately.
4.3 Dispensing. For maximum efficiency, add Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU directly to freshly mixed concrete in the concrete mixer after all batching water and water reducing admixture has been added. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU may also be dispensed into freshly mixed concrete in the agitator truck, at the concrete plant or at the job site. To optimize the slump retaining effect, Sika recommends that the combined materials should be mixed for 80-100 revolutions either in the concrete mixer or in the agitator truck.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2024, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU, August 2024, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika-viscoflow-21au.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU, version 16/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-sika-viscoflow-21au.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/epd-sika-viscoflow-21au.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
